instructions:
Evaluate the assigned retained reference experiment.
Your internal decision may take several model exchanges. Return the required
closed response object. Use response_type=request_context to request your own
prior attempts through the declared lookup form. This only retrieves information
you already received; it does not perform new scientific work or complete an
action. After its decision_lookup_result arrives, continue the SAME decision.
For this protocol, use request_context for own history; episode.history is not
an available action. This replaces the older history-tool instruction.
Use response_type=select_action with selection and report_update when ready to
dispatch an actual action. Only that action's actual completion supplies an
observation to your configured continuation controller.

decision_bootstrap supplies an authoritative scoped model state. decision_update
replaces the listed top-level fields and removes exactly removed_fields; omitted
fields keep their previous values. base_revision identifies the previous state
and revision identifies the resulting state. Newer state replaces older values,
including yield expectations; older estimates remain historical. A bootstrap
after conversation loss or compaction replaces earlier presentation state.
decision_lookup_result supplies only the requested own historical information.
Restored public exchanges preserve the requests and results of an unfinished
decision; do not repeat their already answered lookups merely to restore memory.

action_yields describes your OWN completed action categories. total_yield is
observed signed gain, excluding inherited credit. Expected category yield is
conditional on choosing and completing that category again; unavailable is not
zero. Approximate model bands are not calibrated next-outcome guarantees. Useful
evidence acquisition can have zero immediate credit when a later interpretation
earns the credit. Failed or unexecuted attempts have no completed-action gain.
Use recorded inputs and result references to distinguish specific prior attempts.

changed_annotation_refs.meaning: Actual changed annotation revision references from completed work, filtered by semantic record type.

changed_assessment_refs.meaning: Actual changed assessment revision references from completed work, filtered by semantic record type.

changed_interpretation_account_refs.meaning: Actual changed episode-owned coherent interpretation accounts; these are not parent annotation revisions.

changed_record_refs.meaning: New or revised semantic records explicitly identified as changed by recorded work.

committed_record_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by completed own work and completed child investigations.

credit.meaning: Projected credit at child completion for its fixed assigned scope; redelivery preserves that snapshot.

episode_yield.meaning: Recorded closing local numerical forecast and continuation decision, in the child's configured controller units. It is not task credit, a job ETA, a parent instruction or goal completion. Null when the controller does not expose the supported typed numerical state. Normal status is 0; -1 means insufficient observations and -2 means unidentifiable, not negative predicted gain.

completed_actions.description: Completed own actions at this child's level; an investigation commissioned by it counts once.

continuation_cost.description: The actual child's decision threshold in its configured controller units.

alpha.description: Original band parameter: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; otherwise the configured tail parameter.

lower.description: The original band's lower coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

status_code.description: 0 normal; -1 insufficient observations; -2 unidentifiable. Coded coordinates are not negative forecasts.

uncertainty_code.description: -1 unavailable; 0 exact; 1 Chebyshev; 2 Laplace approximation. The code does not establish calibrated coverage.

upper.description: The original band's upper coordinate; read status_code before interpreting it.

value.description: The original band point in this child's configured controller units.

stop_requested.description: The child's controller decision, not a parent instruction, job cancellation or scientific completion.

interpretation_basis_refs.meaning: Semantic references visible to the last admitted report interpretation response and available at this report boundary, including source-window custody and admitted typed forms. A visible handle does not establish that its full record or source body was read.

last_outcome_refs.meaning: Semantic records returned by the last completed own ordinary action.

literature_amount_cells.meaning: Saved A105 source amount components with both quantities' actual roles, preparation/stock, method, basis, qualification and covariance ownership. Target/total mass-fraction estimates differ from nominal molar arm comparisons. Conditional denominator conversion is not applied to a rate; uncertainty and unknown relationships remain explicit, without target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_assay_cells.meaning: Saved source-anchored assay interpretations and numerical operands/corrections. Endpoint and arrangement describe the episode's source interpretation. Known-normal indices remain conditional and are not function probabilities. Unknown operands remain null.

literature_binding_cells.meaning: Saved source binding-parameter components with actual protein/state/ligand comparison, uncertainty basis and reported-limit arithmetic. Limits are not confidence or true-parameter bounds; IC50 is not Kd. Missing inputs and unimplemented observation models remain explicit.

literature_binding_interaction_cells.meaning: Eight saved native source binding-discrimination interaction components for two molecular forms and two ligands. A requested raw parameter row alone expands that role's numerical source readings and partial uncertainty. Derived rows preserve source meaning/status references without unrequested operand numbers. Unknown common kind does not imply IC50; the model/covariance source reader is unimplemented, not a paper omission. No target transfer or annotation credit.

literature_binding_model_cells.meaning: Saved conditional source log-parameter contrast, full-covariance noise and signed likelihood/index components for test parameter exceeding reference. Known/estimated variance, actual censor mechanism and model origin stay explicit. Native reporting limits are not point observations or confidence bounds; these are not probabilities of function or target-transfer scores.

literature_context_cells.meaning: Saved organism/sample compatibility bounds with the original capability-versus-coverage question, actual context frame, weights, pairing, mapping and domain qualifications. Unpaired fractions use bounds; unexamined biological situations remain unknown. Conditional Hoeffding sampling is separate from logical domains and requires the actual independent context design. Source assay observations are not additional biological samples, target-transfer weights or annotation credit.

literature_figure_cells.meaning: Saved native experimental graph ordinates and signed differences with both molecule/partner arms, endpoint/normalization, source representation relationships and repeat/spread meanings. Bounds describe conditional pixel digitization, not SD or confidence intervals. Coupled product or partner-swap differences do not establish upstream-only activity, partner necessity, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_kinetic_cells.meaning: Saved native kinetic parameter and descriptive contrast components, preserving per-operand subject/construct, source protocols, qualification and actual uncertainty meanings. Only the five native cells are supported by this route. Its covariance/model source reader is unimplemented, not a source finding. Ratio, difference and log contrast are dependent representations, not independent experimental support or annotation credit.

literature_optical_cells.meaning: Saved projections of existing net_rate(q) and variance_net_rate(Vq) inputs for the source NADH-depletion endpoint, conditional on the selected optical relationships. Preserve actual subject/construct/preparation/conditions, source qualifications, local reuse and covariance ownership. This is not isolated product formation, recovery k, protein amount, corrected activity, target transfer, annotation credit or independent evidence from another rate representation.

literature_partner_cells.meaning: Saved experimental partner-removal and addback components with actual molecule/partner identities, nonpartner-condition comparisons, normalization, physical observation identity and reported spread meanings. Native rates survive unavailable controlled comparisons. Bounds condition on supplied censor domains and exact reported means; they are not sampling confidence. Directed condition-specific dependence does not establish universal necessity, genomic presence, coexpression, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_perturbation_cells.meaning: Saved reference-perturbation effects and proposed restoration components, retaining actual recipient/construct/partner and endpoint meanings. Calibrated same-endpoint contrasts, real restoration, nuisance comparability and effect isolation are distinct. Missing quantitative outcomes and uncertainty remain unknown. The proposed source index is not target correspondence or annotation credit.

component.description: Native reference/perturbed/restored outcomes and separate effect, restoration, nuisance amount and isolation components. The reference index combines their declared orientation and proposed conventions; it is not target correspondence or probability. Joint uncertainty remains unreported.

literature_quantity_cells.meaning: Saved single reported source quantities, with quantity and analyte identity. Untyped spread remains untyped. Source conditions, attribution and correction scores remain unknown where unsupported.

literature_rate_cells.meaning: Saved source-preparation rate cells with measured subject/experiment retained in the referenced sheet. Conditional statistics are not annotation probabilities or target-transfer scores; unavailable operands remain null with reasons.

literature_rate_source_cells.meaning: The same saved numerical rate components from native source spans, with each arm's actual subject/construct/preparation bindings and approximation retained. Source-supported conditional statistical assumptions do not establish causal isolation, target transfer or annotation credit. This closed native return view is distinct from the legacy table view, not a second scoring sheet.

literature_ratio_cells.meaning: Reported comparative signal components with actual denominator/arrangement, received representation candidates and source origins. Conflicts are not sampling intervals. Calibration and functional response/uncertainty remain separate missing inputs.

literature_reaction_cells.meaning: Saved reported reference reaction-ratio residuals, fixed named-prediction comparisons and simple resource budgets. Source summary uncertainty and incomplete resources remain explicit unknowns. Product-pair ratios and supplied reagent coverage do not establish consumption, native capacity or measured coupling. Logical domain bounds are not confidence intervals; no target correspondence or annotation credit is calculated.

literature_structure_cells.meaning: Saved conditional source-model geometry and local residue RSCC components with exact source bindings. Entry/revision validation, fixed required panels, proposed physical predicates and unreported coordinate/measurement uncertainty remain explicit. Conditional state/assignment identities do not establish population occupancy, causal isolation or target annotation credit.

literature_transport_cells.meaning: Saved native concentrations and conditional same-curve kinetic-response components. condition_response is test substrate saturation divided by reference substrate saturation under the same fitted curve. Keep actual curve/preparation identities, Km uncertainty meaning and full covariance ownership. The response can divide an appropriate source effect once; it is not reliability or annotation credit. Missing or different curves remain unavailable.

component.description: condition_response is test substrate saturation divided by reference substrate saturation under the same fitted kinetic curve. It can divide an appropriate source effect once as a conditional response correction; it is not a reliability grade.

observations_after_report_basis.meaning: Last ordinary-action observations not supplied to that interpretation response.

pending_handles.meaning: Original selected child executions still pending when this episode closed. These handles survive parent closure; closure does not cancel them or establish scientific completion.

subject_refs.meaning: Original input subjects assigned by the parent.

child_population_operations.description: Calculate a conditional source substrate-response correction from exact concentration spans and a received saved apparent-Km quantity. Full covariance retains physical owners and shared Km once; no sampling variance from untyped spread, target transfer or annotation credit is inferred.
child_population_operations.name: literature.transport.response.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate reference perturbation/restoration components from source-bound design interpretations and optional received quantitative data. Keep actual recipient, changed component, partner, endpoint calibration and real restoration arms distinct. Qualitative-only outcomes cannot supply numerical rates. Preserve nuisance comparability separately from effect isolation and leave missing inputs/uncertainty unknown. No target transfer, necessity inference from an unmeasured catalytic knockout, or final annotation credit.

child_population_operations.description: Populate source-model geometry and local residue RSCC components from received coordinates and optional matching deposited validation. Select exact model/author atom groups and fixed physical criteria. Preserve missing endpoints, validation entry/revision mismatch and unreported coordinate uncertainty. The explicit scope is conditional deposited-model geometry; it does not establish population occupancy, causal mechanism, target correspondence or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.structure.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate reported reference reaction-ratio residuals, named-prediction comparisons and simple resource-budget components from an explicitly retained received dataset. Preserve unknown replication, missing alternatives and incomplete resource constraints. Product-pair ratios, supplied reagent budgets and usable capacity have distinct meanings. This route does not parse NMR spectra, establish measured oxygen coupling, apply missing corrections or calculate target transfer/annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.reaction.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate biological context compatibility from source-bound retained observations and domain/route meanings. Keep organism capability distinct from fixed-sample coverage; preserve physical unit bases, missing local mapping, unexamined states, sample weights, pairing and conditional sampling design. Logical domain bounds are not confidence intervals or intuitive quality grades. Purified-enzyme assays are not automatically organism witnesses or habitat samples. No target correspondence or annotation credit is calculated.
child_population_operations.name: literature.context.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read native experimental mean-bar ordinates from received original images using a retained linear-axis selection recipe. Preserve both subject/partner arms, endpoint and normalization meanings, source representation relationships, reported repeat/spread meanings and conditional digitization bounds. Return raw ordinates and a signed difference; pixel extraction does not supply SD, statistical significance, molar calibration, partner necessity or target credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.figure.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate source experimental partner-removal and addback components from received retained measurements and exact source witnesses. Preserve directed molecule/partner roles, nitrogen and other nonpartner conditions, normalization identity, physical measurement identity and reported spread meanings. Incompatible or incomplete comparisons keep native values and explicit unknown components. Censor domains are not confidence intervals; chemical bypass and partner swaps do not establish universal partner necessity, genomic presence, target transfer or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.partner.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate the same experimental partner components directly from selected literal source spans. Select complete rate/limit tokens, native units, spread meanings and source-bound entity/physical-measurement identities; do not supply scientific numbers or a prepared numeric JSON dataset. For source-defined activity units such as U/mg, select the endpoint-specific definition, quantity, molecular entity and time basis; no universal U conversion is assumed. Deterministic readers preserve original tokens, convert supported rate units and retain unknown normalization, conditions or observation identity. A repeated representation is not a new measurement. No sampling uncertainty, universal necessity, target correspondence or annotation credit is inferred.
child_population_operations.name: literature.partner.source.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate the existing source-rate comparison sheet directly from selected literal paper spans, without a prepared CSV/TSV or model-authored scientific numbers. Request its closed literature_rate_source_cells return projection, which preserves each arm's subject, construct, preparation and approximation; literature_rate_cells is the separate legacy table projection. Select source-backed endpoint/basis relationships and statistical assumptions; different constructs may be the intended comparison. Source-defined U/mg requires its endpoint-specific definition. Missing meanings, unsupported units and censored values retain partial inputs. Exact witnesses verify custody, not causal isolation, target correspondence or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.rate.source.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate A105 source amount components from exact reported numerical/unit spans and witnessed experimental meanings. Keep target/total same-stock mass-fraction estimates separate from nominal molar amounts between arms. Preserve both quantity roles, preparations, methods, bases, bounds, approximation and source-owned covariance. Ratios above one and missing relationships remain explicit; no active fraction, universal activity correction, target transfer or annotation credit is inferred. The conditional mass-denominator factor is retained without applying it to a saved rate.
child_population_operations.name: literature.amount.populate

child_population_operations.description: Populate the existing net_rate and variance_net_rate input meanings from selected source-bound optical observations. Preserve NADH-depletion endpoint scope, actual subject/construct/preparation/conditions, qualified or missing inputs and source-owned covariance. Optical epsilon/path conversion is not recovery k, protein amount, product attribution or a complete activity score. Repeated representations create no independent evidence or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.optical.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read source-bound reported Km, kcat or catalytic-efficiency estimates and populate native parameter, difference, ratio and log-contrast components for separately assayed substrates. Preserve actual molecule/construct, per-row protocols, qualifications and source uncertainty meanings. This native route has no covariance/model source reader; model-dependent evidence cells are not supported here, which is not a finding that the paper lacks covariance. No quotient of reported means, common-condition correction, intrinsic-affinity inference, target transfer or annotation credit.
child_population_operations.name: literature.kinetic.populate

child_population_operations.description: Read four selected original-image binding cells for two separately assayed source molecular forms and two ligands. Populate native IC50 or reported Hill-fit Kd parameters, within-form ligand ratios and their interaction/log interaction. Preserve actual source meanings, physical-fit identity, uncertain or conflicting readings, units, limits and partial uncertainty; unknown common kind retains raw results without choosing a default. Covariance/model source reading is unimplemented here, not a finding about the paper. No intrinsic-affinity conversion, target transfer or annotation credit.

anchor.quote: Equilibrium competition fluorescence assays were used to determine whether wild-type apo-IscR and apo-IscR-E43A discriminate at positions 7 and 8 of the hya site. In these assays, 8–1000 nM of competitor containing a single nucleotide mutation at position 7 or 8 was combined with 5 nM Texas Red labeled wild-type hya in 40 mM Tris-Cl (pH 7.9), 250 mM KCl, 5% glycerol, 10 uM DTT buffer under anaerobic conditions, 22 nM apo-IscR or 20 nM apo-IscR-E43A was added, then fluorescence was measured as described above. The fraction bound was determined using the equation (A − Afree)/(Abound − Afree), where A is the anisotropy of a sample, Afree is the anisotropy of the DNA in the absence of IscR, and Abound is the anisotropy in the absence of competitor. The IC50 was determined by fitting a four parameter logistic curve to the data (SigmaPlot 12.0). All assays to generate binding isotherms and competition data were repeated on at least three independent occasions.

input.text:
TASK

Evaluate what the assigned experimental sources establish about the reference molecule and its possible function. Keep the actual caller question, supplied material, scientific scope and constraints below as your job. A function can emerge from the evidence; an initial annotation or public searchable name is not required. Decide which uncertainty is useful to resolve next, choose among the permitted source operations and literature investigations, and revise your interpretation using actual outcomes.

Establish which organism, genotype, molecule, construct, preparation and experimental system each result concerns. Distinguish the source organism from an expression host, a tagged construct from a native molecule, and a reference preparation from the supplied annotation target. Preserve the actual measured entity, endpoint, units, normalization, comparison numerator and denominator, conditions, intended experimental change and controls. A shared name, source paper or equal number does not establish a common experiment or molecular identity.

Judge the bearing of the measured endpoint on the specific functional assertion. Molecular conversion, transport and binding experiments answer different questions from growth, survival or other perturbation/restoration phenotypes. A recovery-growth result is not an enzyme activity measurement. A band-signal ratio is not calibrated molar or active protein amount. A no-inhibitor reference is not a no-enzyme blank. Oxygen consumption does not itself identify product formation or a quantitative productive coupling ratio. Keep the source's observation separate from the authors' inference and from your interpretation.

Keep experimental comparability outside the deliberately tested difference separate from isolation of the measured effect. Ask which amounts or conditions could explain a comparison, whether molecules replace one another or coexist, and which contributors remain in a mixed readout. Similar conditions do not prove attribution. A complementary experiment can address a named weakness without becoming independent replication. Preserve contradictions and source-representation conflicts; measurements on different endpoints or conditions are not automatically inconsistent repeats.

When a narrower literature investigation is useful, define its actual question, source scope, constraints and requested typed information. Ask for the numerical components and experimental relationships needed for your next decision, including relevant uncertainty, controls, unavailable reasons and source identity. Use the declared return projections to construct a closed form; retain actual reference meanings and select only the needed components. Children own their iterative source search, reading and interpretation choices. Their permitted relationships are alternatives, not a required itinerary, reading quota or automatic sequence.

Integrate only information actually received through your own outcomes or requested admitted child forms. A globally stored source or a reference needed for validation is not delivered scientific knowledge. Read scoped evidence when needed. Preserve units, bounds, uncertainty definitions, experimental meaning and dependence when comparing results. Missing values remain unknown; nondetection is not exact zero. Do not convert SD, SEM, confidence intervals or untyped error bars into one another, count technical repetitions as independent experiments, or count repeated representations as new evidence. Models identify source meanings and supported operands; deterministic operations perform parsing, validation, unit conversion and arithmetic.

A numerical source-effect component evaluates its declared experiment and endpoint. It is not a probability of function, target annotation support or investigation-progress credit. Source findings may qualify or weaken a proposed function while still being useful information. Sequence/structural correspondence and later combination into annotation credit remain separate work. Do not invent target-transfer weights, reliability categories, missing controls, covariance or scientific progress. Do not manufacture target assessments merely to give source processing credit or hasten stopping.

Retain valid partial results and actionable source limitations. Your task remains this parent investigation after a child return; the admitted return is evidence for your next decision, not another task prompt. Use ordinary reasoning to integrate findings and update only your declared typed report when one is requested. Do not add a second model call to restate recorded facts or compose a report. Source navigation, bookkeeping and report construction add no scientific contribution by themselves. The configured controller owns continuation; there is no source-completion gate or fixed action count.

When requesting saved numerical experimental components from a child, copy the declared projection schema into your chosen top-level return field, including its exact `x-source` selector. Choose the needed components through the child assignment. Keep bound fact fields out of `initial_report_json`; the runtime fills them from saved results. Use separate constrained fields for interpretations and unresolved questions. Do not ask the child to rewrite saved numerical cells as model-authored report values.

Evaluate the assigned retained reference experiment.
Your internal decision may take several model exchanges. Return the required
closed response object. Use response_type=request_context to request your own
prior attempts through the declared lookup form. This only retrieves information
you already received; it does not perform new scientific work or complete an
action. After the requested information arrives, continue the SAME decision.
For this protocol, use request_context for own history; episode.history is not
an available action. This replaces the older history-tool instruction.
Use response_type=select_action with selection and report_update when ready to
dispatch an actual action. Only that action's actual completion supplies an
